IF
StatusApplied(_Player,"UND_STRENGTH_CHAIR",S_UND_StrengthChair_95409119-5348-4b46-af92-627d1ea8ef07,_)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
NOT DB_UND_StrengthChairAD(_Player,_)
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD(UND_SussurTower_PAD_StrengthChair_170e9485-b967-d045-b69d-1d6cf1918f55,_Player);
DB_UND_StrengthChairAD(_Player,0);

IF
DB_InRegion(_Player, (TRIGGER)S_CRE_GremishkaLurezone_02f8d8ca-b24c-476e-a5fa-ddb02c0cf7a8)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
DB_AmbushTrigger_Ambusher(S_CRE_GremishkaAmbushTrigger_99df15d5-bce2-4421-8bcd-ee0f8610ab9a, _,1)
AND
QRY_OncePerUserAndNearbyPlayers(_Player,"CRE_LibraryGremishkaCry")
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD((DIALOGRESOURCE)CRE_Library_AD_GremishkaCry_34aed394-e972-2902-0549-ff35249f0a38, (ITEM)S_CRE_InvisibleGremishkaCrySource_9fa36d11-570e-49fa-ad2a-4b7579da83ad);
DB_CRE_GremishkaCry_Listener(_Player);

PROC
PROC_ApplySavegamePatches()
AND
QRY_BG3_SaveGameIsOlderThan("Release Patch 1")
AND
DB_ShovelArea(S_CRE_BuriedMound_06_b996fbf6-9620-4b0f-937c-460d0e9b99c4, _)
AND
NOT DB_LevelUnreachable("CRE_Main_A")
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(CRE_HungryBird_State_RewardGiven_e155685d-9e99-4eff-874a-1f2754a29ac9)
AND
DB_Avatars(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_BUGFIX_Marker("GUS-300489")
THEN
DB_BUGFIX_Marker("GUS-300489");
DB_GLO_Bugfix_300489_RevealCrecheMound(_Player);

PROC
PROC_CorpseCleanup_CreateLootbag((CHARACTER)_Corpse)
AND
DB_ActiveLevel(_)
AND
DB_Origins(_Corpse)
AND
IsInventoryEmpty(_Corpse,0)
AND
GetPosition(_Corpse,_X,_Y,_Z)
AND
CreateAt((ITEMROOT)LOOT_GEN_Backpack_D_Posed_A_Colorvar_B_f697d433-7b8f-4fe1-8fe3-990bdfeedeee,_X,_Y,_Z,0,0,"CorpseCleanup_LootbagReady",_BackPack)
THEN
DB_CorpseCleanup_DeferredWait(_Corpse,_BackPack);
DB_CorpseCleanup_Lootbag(_BackPack);
